dog.description_text:
Meet Floyd, a sweet, bashful boy who knows that good things come to those who give him treats and a little playtime!

Floyd’s playful personality shines once he gets totally comfortable, and he may even have a few things to say during playtime. He also enjoys saying hello to some of his doggy friends while out on walks. And just wait until you see his stunning smile and pearly white teeth in person!

Give Floyd a little time to get to know you, and you'll discover that underneath that coy exterior is a total lovebug who is ready to steal your heart! Click the “Adopt Me” button to learn more.

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
dog.name: FLOYD
